descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S20 「两个模式下 Settings 都显示账号、Privacy Policy、Delete account、支持和版本，Sign out 结束会话」 Settings shows the account, Privacy Policy, Delete account, support and version in both modes, and Sign out ends the session

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T5 Sign out ends the session. The physician must sign in again with an email code.（TFA-94700 AC 2）
  • T11 Settings shows the signed-in physician's email, Sign out, Privacy Policy, Delete account, a Support contact and the app version, the same way in Hospital and in Nursing Home. …（TFA-94700 AC 1；TFA-94700 AC 3；TFA-94700 AC 7）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given A brand-new account signed in through the browser (settings-account.spec.ts); a phone and browser session pair (sign-in-devices.spec.ts); two API sessions (api/session-security.spec.ts)

When Open /settings in Hospital and in Nursing Home; press Sign out in the browser; call the API with a signed-out session

Then In both modes Settings shows 'Signed in as <email>', Sign out, Sign out everywhere, Delete account, a Privacy Policy link to https://roundcompanion.com/privacy.html opening in a new tab, Contact support as mailto:vikram@roundcompanion.com, and 'Version x.y.z (commit)'. Sign out lands on the sign-in screen and leaves the phone signed in. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：settings-account.spec.ts, sign-in-devices.spec.ts and api/session-security.spec.ts assertions, judged against T11 (TFA-94700 AC 1; AC 3's link target; AC 7 both modes) and T5 (AC 2: sign in again with an email code). The scenario lists only ungated TFA-94700 requirements, so a failure reports as Fail on the ready-for-qa ticket. Whether the privacy page itself opens is S23; …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S20

Settings shows the account, Privacy Policy, Delete account, support and version in both modes, and Sign out ends the session

Tickets: TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/session-security.spec.ts [api] — signing out ends the session and leaves a signed_out row — expected
  • settings-account.spec.ts [chromium] — Settings shows the account, privacy policy and version the same way in Hospital and Nursing Home — expected
  • sign-in-devices.spec.ts [chromium] — Sign out ends this device only; Sign out everywhere ends the phone too — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs, which sign in their own fixture accounts and need the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
